description: E12 (extension X3, amended): Kirby-Love invariance test and graded contextual fraction vs temperature.

plan.metric: (a) whether the Kirby-Love flag of the 1e-8 support of phi(H) ever differs from the flag of the term set over the T grid; (b) epsilon-support size, flag and greedy contextual fraction vs T
plan.decision_rule: (a) the invariance claim is refuted by a single noncontextual set whose support becomes contextual at some T, for any activation; (b) report medians over 20 draws per (family, n, epsilon, T); the contextual fraction is an upper bound (greedy)
